hooks.logic:
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list2.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of the enemy, then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  If ability is the id of the move labelled "double_magic" on the enemy, then the enemy uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityTag: "double_magic"}, {abilityTag: list at (_ → random with (the length of list minus 1))}, {abilityTag: list at (_ → random with (the length of list minus 1))}].
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability.
